samples.xml_description:
<module id="up_down_counter">
    <description>A 16-bit counter that can increment or decrement based on control signals.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="reset">Reset signal to initialize the counter to zero.</input>
        <input id="up_down">Control signal to determine counting direction.</input>
        <output id="count" width_description="[15:0]">Current count value.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>Counts up or down based on the up_down signal.</implementation>
</module>
